block: SQ1-LATAM (Brazil and Latin America sub-strategy: PT, ES and EN studies set in Latin America; agricultural pesticide exposure including aerial spraying and birth outcomes; context arm for Chapada do Apodi, Baixo Jaguaribe, Limoeiro do Norte and Ceará). PRESS 2015 peer review of the calibration result, with re-tests. I ran 20 checks (T1–T20). Up to T5 they went through mcp__Firecrawl__firecrawl_scrape. From T6 on, all OpenAlex, SciELO and BVS calls went through mcp__Parallel_Search__web_fetch, because Firecrawl reported that the account is low on credits; the user should add credits before the main search runs. The T6–T9 context-arm counts were run on OpenAlex. Every count below was returned by the API or portal. T1 reproduced the original OA-1 (E3 AND O3 AND G) at exactly 464.

press_items.assessment:
The design (effect arm E AND O AND G, plus PT/ES branch, aerial-spraying arm and place-name context arm) translates PECOS well. It has three conceptual gaps that cost relevant records.
(a) G treats 'Latin America' as country names only. Brazilian ecological studies usually name a state or municipality, not the country.
(b) The French Caribbean is outside G. The Guadeloupe/Martinique chlordecone banana-plantation birth cohort (TIMOUN) is the closest crop analogue to Ceará's banana dose, and it is missed.
(c) The context arm is limited to six or seven place names. It misses Ceará-wide pesticide and health studies, and the policy/legal literature on the ban itself (Lei Zé Maria do Tomé, ADI 6137), which Essay 2 needs.
The calibration also never stated scope decisions on Puerto Rico (PROTECT cohort: glyphosate and preterm birth) and on occupational cohorts (Colombian and Ecuadorian floriculture, Mexican floriculture LBW).
press_items.suggested_change:
1. Expand G with Brazilian states, demonyms, SINASC/DATASUS and the Caribbean including the French Antilles (G4 in the recommended query).
2. Add a legal/policy arm.
3. Write explicit eligibility notes on Puerto Rico and on occupational exposure (screen as 'occupational, indirect').
press_items.tested:
T4. E3 AND O3 AND (G-expansion NOT G) = 89 hits. Relevant: Mato Grosso 2022 (10.56238/sevcipcsv1-021), Mato Grosso 2024 (10.36489/saudecoletiva.2023v13i88p13488-13494), Mato Grosso 2026 (10.25248/reas.e23742.2026), Marialva-PR 2026 (10.33872/saudeglobal.v4n1.e036), RS 2023 (10.1590/0103-1104202313813), Pernambuco 2023 (10.16891/2317-434x.v11.e2.a2023.pp1829-1839), Javeriana 2019 (10.11144/javeriana.rgsp18-36.imcp), Dutra 2019, Ecuadorian cut-flower studies. Noise: Puerto Rico, Suriname, Belize.
T10. (E3+chlordecone) AND O3 AND (Guadeloupe|Martinique|Antilles|'French West Indies'|chlordecone NOT G) = 32. Includes Kadhel 2014 (10.1093/aje/kwt313, preterm birth), Hervé 2016 (10.1016/j.envres.2016.08.004, birth weight) and Rouget 2019 (10.1007/s11356-019-06031-y, congenital anomalies); rat studies come in through 'chlordecone/kepone'.
T9. Legal phrases = 63, which includes 'Lei Zé Maria do Tomé' papers, 10.54033/cadpedv22n7-345 and 10.18174/442443.

press_items.assessment:
The calibration's syntax claims hold: comma-separated filters are ANDed, OR and NOT work, and NOT across parenthesised groups works (confirmed in x_query). There are three structural defects.
(i) OA-2 uses language:pt|es as a recall branch. Records with language = null drop out of both OA-1 and OA-2. T16 showed Marialva-PR 2026 and Mato Grosso 2026 are language:null, and both are missed. The Uruguay 2024 Ambiente & Sociedade paper is tagged 'en'.
(ii) The mandatory three-way AND needs a country token in title or abstract.
(iii) The context arm OA-4 is a phrase-only toponym AND, and it does NOT contain Rigotto et al. 2013 (10.1590/s1415-790x2013000300019). That record turns up in the T7 delta (CTX3 NOT CTX2), so OA-4 misses it. It reaches the union only through OA-1. The context arm is fragile.
OpenAlex has no proximity operator. That is acceptable.
press_items.suggested_change:
1. Collapse OA-1 and OA-2 into one branch using the expanded G4. Keep OA-2 only as an optional safety net, since its union with the revised branch was not re-counted.
2. Rebuild the context arm as (CTX2 OR CTX3) AND PEST2, plus a separate (Ceará OR Ceara) AND pesticide line.
3. Present the strategy as numbered lines (#1 E, #2 O, #3 G, #4 = #1 AND #2 AND #3, ...).
press_items.tested:
T16. 8 new candidate items: 8/8 are indexed in OpenAlex.
T17. Original OA-1 retrieves 1/8 (Avila-Vazquez 2018, 10.4236/jep.2018.93016).
T18. Original OA-2 retrieves 2/8 (Pernambuco 2023, RS 2023). OA-1 ∪ OA-2 = 3/8.
T19. Revised single branch E4 AND O4 AND G4 = 604 hits (original OA-1 = 464; original OA-1 ∪ OA-2 = 625).
T20. The revised branch retrieves 12/12 of the 8 new items plus the 3 effect seeds (Dias 2023, Calzada 2023, Camacho & Mejía 2017) plus Dutra 2019. Caveat: the 8 items were found partly through the delta queries themselves (T2, T4, T10), so 12/12 shows the revisions work. It is not an unbiased recall estimate.

press_items.assessment:
OpenAlex and SciELO have no thesaurus. That is acceptable, but PRESS expects controlled vocabulary wherever it exists. The calibration left the LILACS DeCS version untested (502 errors). I tested it.
- mh: syntax works with English descriptor names.
- DeCS-only (Pesticides | Agrochemicals | Herbicides | Insecticides | 'Fungicides, Industrial' | Agricultural Workers' Diseases) AND (Pregnancy Outcome | Infant, Low Birth Weight | Premature Birth | Congenital Abnormalities | Fetal Death | Abortion, Spontaneous | Infant Mortality | Stillbirth | Prenatal Exposure Delayed Effects) = 29 LILACS records. They include Salta (Argentina) LBW and agroquímicos, Minas Gerais monoculture malformations, Paraná congenital anomaly spatial study, and Llay-Llay (Chile) spontaneous abortion.
- DeCS NOT L1 = 2.
So free-text L1 is already sensitive, but the DeCS line adds records and should be ORed in.
press_items.suggested_change: L1' = L1 OR (DeCS line above). Optional, untested: SciELO kw: field for author keywords; OpenAlex topics or concepts filter as an extra sensitivity line.
press_items.tested:
T14: BVS portal, filter[db][]=LILACS, DeCS-only = 29.
T15: DeCS AND NOT L1 = 2.

press_items.assessment:
The calibration's known-item results miss several text-word gaps. I verified them with NOT-delta queries (records retrieved only by the new terms).

Exposure:
- 'agrochemical(s)' is missing. The Uruguay 2024 effect study ('Agrochemicals and negative effects on obstetric outcomes in Uruguay', 10.1590/1809-4422asoc00761vu27l3oa) is missed by every OpenAlex branch.
- Molecule names are missing: mancozeb and chlorpyrifos (ISA Costa Rica 2014 abstract, 10.1289/isee.2014.o-075, 'In utero mancozeb and chlorpyrifos exposure ... decreased fetal growth'), procymidone/procimidona (the Chapada residue), and chlordecone.
- 'aplicação aérea', 'aviação agrícola' and 'pulverizações aéreas' (plural not stemmed) appear only in OA-3, not in OA-1's E block.

Outcome:
- Broad additions ('prenatal exposure', 'in utero', 'maternal exposure', 'child health', 'reproductive health', 'malformaciones') add 151 records. Almost all are off-target (neurodevelopment, leukaemia, sperm, rat studies), so I reject them.
- Targeted additions are warranted: 'fetal mortality', 'mortalidade fetal', 'mortalidad fetal', 'muerte fetal', natimortos, mortinatos, 'óbitos fetais' (fetal death is a first-line channel per flag 6/SIM), prematuridad (the standard Spanish form; 'prematurez' is rare), 'parto prematuro', 'parto pretérmino', 'pré-termo', 'defectos congénitos', 'neural tube defects', 'obstetric outcomes', 'abortamentos espontâneos', 'sex ratio at birth' (Paraná 2008, 10.1590/s1020-49892008001000003).

Context:
- Missing variants: 'Chapada de Apodi' (preposition variant; the phrase 'Chapada do Apodi' misses it), bare Apodi / 'Apodi plateau', 'Lower Jaguaribe', 'Vale do Jaguaribe' / 'Jaguaribe Valley', 'Tabuleiro de Russas', Russas, Jaguaruana.
- Missing: Ceará AND pesticide. It surfaces 'Pulverização aérea de agrotóxicos no Brasil' (2025), the ADI 6137 paper (10.26668/indexlawjournals/2526-0081/2023.v9i2.10012), Jaguaribe River pesticide fate (10.1007/s11368-016-1597-9) and childhood cancer in exposed communities in Ceará (10.22533/at.ed.92920110213).
press_items.suggested_change:
1. Add to E: agrochemicals, agrochemical, 'agricultural chemicals', agroquímico, agroquimico, mancozeb, chlorpyrifos, clorpirifós, organophosphate(s), organofosforados, paraquat, atrazine, procymidone, procimidona, chlordecone, 'pesticide drift', 'spray drift', 'pulverizações aéreas', 'aplicação aérea', 'aviação agrícola'. Do NOT add bare fungicidas/herbicidas/insecticidas/fitosanitarios in OpenAlex: they pull agronomy noise into the T2 delta.
2. Add only the targeted outcome terms listed above.
3. Context arm: add CTX3 terms with a pesticide/agribusiness co-term rather than generic 'saúde/health'. The generic version gave 481 hits with Limoeiro-PE and Staraya Russa noise; the tight version gave 88.

press_items.assessment:
Problems found:
- No line-numbered search history. Each branch is a single monolithic string, which makes it hard to audit or reuse.
- OpenAlex does not fold accents, yet the context terms are given only with accents: 'Zé Maria do Tomé', Quixeré, 'Dossiê ABRASCO'. Add 'Ze Maria do Tome', Quixere and 'Dossie ABRASCO'. I included them in T6, but their separate contribution was not isolated.
- In a legal arm, '16.820' brings in chemistry and numeric noise (T9: crystal-structure papers). Drop it.
- SciELO S1 uses fumigacion*, which misses English 'fumigation' (the calibration flagged this but did not test it). A SciELO exposure delta (agrochem*, agroqu*, fumiga*, pulveriz*, mancozeb, organofosf*, organophosph*, NOT the S1 exposure terms) AND S1 outcomes = 21 records, mostly Ciência Rural and veterinary noise driven by pulveriz*. So add only agrochem* and fumigat*.
- SciELO S1 does retrieve the Uruguay 2024 paper through its multilingual abstracts. The OpenAlex terms are the weak link.
press_items.suggested_change:
1. Renumber as #1–#9 per database.
2. Add the unaccented context variants.
3. SciELO S1': add agrochem* OR fumigat* to E, and obstetric* OR natimort* OR mortinat* OR pretermin* OR 'mortalidade fetal' OR 'mortalidad fetal' to O. Do not add pulveriz*.
4. Drop '16.820'.

press_items.assessment:
No year or type limits. That is correct for this block.
The language filter is used as a recall device rather than a limit, and it is unreliable for two reasons: OpenAlex assigns language:null to some PT records (T5: 61 of the 89 G-delta records are not tagged pt or es, including relevant language:null items), and it tags multilingual SciELO records as 'en'.
Volume after revision stays screenable:
- Revised effect branch: 604 (+140 vs OA-1 alone; 21 fewer than the original OA-1 ∪ OA-2 = 625). It retrieved all 12 test items.
- Tight context delta: +88.
- Ceará AND pesticide: +218 before overlap with the context arm.
- Legal arm: +63, minus '16.820' noise.
That is roughly +350–450 records before deduplication. Puerto Rico, Suriname and Belize add some Caribbean noise (T4), but it can be cleared quickly at title stage.
press_items.suggested_change:
1. Drop the language branch as a primary device. Keep it only as a supplementary line, or replace it with G4.
2. Report in the protocol that OpenAlex language metadata is incomplete.
3. Keep no date limit.
4. State the expected screening load. With the revised strategy, my estimate for OpenAlex is about 1,300–1,600 unique records plus 377 SciELO and about 525 LILACS before deduplication. This is an estimate, not a count.

#6 Aerial arm = OA-3 as in the calibration, adding "pulverizações aéreas" OR aeroagrícola OR "aerial spraying ban" to its first block. Not re-counted.

#7 Context arm (flag 'context') = (("Chapada do Apodi" OR "Chapada de Apodi" OR "Limoeiro do Norte" OR "Baixo Jaguaribe" OR Quixeré OR Quixere OR "Zé Maria do Tomé" OR "Ze Maria do Tome" OR "Dossiê ABRASCO" OR "Dossie ABRASCO" OR "Jaguaribe-Apodi" OR "Jaguaribe Apodi" OR Apodi OR "Lower Jaguaribe" OR "Jaguaribe Valley" OR "Vale do Jaguaribe" OR "Tabuleiro de Russas" OR Russas OR Jaguaruana) AND (agrotóxicos OR agrotóxico OR agrotoxicos OR agrotoxico OR pesticides OR pesticidas OR plaguicidas OR agrochemicals OR agribusiness OR agronegócio OR fruticultura OR "fruit farming" OR "fruit growing" OR "pulverização aérea" OR "perímetro irrigado" OR "perímetros irrigados" OR "irrigated perimeter" OR saúde OR health OR mulheres)). #8 Ceará arm (flag 'context') = (Ceará OR Ceara) AND (agrotóxicos OR agrotóxico OR agrotoxicos OR agrotoxico OR pesticides OR plaguicidas OR pesticidas OR "pulverização aérea" OR "aerial spraying" OR agrochemicals OR glyphosate OR glifosato OR fungicides). 218 records not already in the original context arm.

#9 Legal/policy arm (flag 'context / Essay 2') = ("ADI 6137" OR "Zé Maria do Tomé" OR "Ze Maria do Tome" OR "proibição da pulverização aérea" OR "vedação da pulverização aérea" OR "aerial spraying ban" OR "ban on aerial spraying" OR "prohibition of aerial spraying" OR "aerial spraying prohibition" OR "prohibición de la fumigación aérea" OR "prohibición de las fumigaciones aéreas"). The tested version, which also contained "16.820", gave 63; drop "16.820".

Final OpenAlex set = #4 OR #5 OR #6 OR #7 OR #8 OR #9.

SCIELO (search.scielo.org, all indices)
S1' = (agrot* OR pesticid* OR plaguicid* OR praguicid* OR herbicid* OR fungicid* OR inseticid* OR insecticid* OR glifosato OR glyphosate OR agroquimic* OR agrochem* OR fumigacion* OR fumigat* OR "pulverização aérea" OR "aerial spraying") AND (nascer OR nacer OR birth* OR prematur* OR preterm OR pretermin* OR congenit* OR congênit* OR malforma* OR fetal OR fetais OR perinata* OR neonata* OR newborn* OR "recém-nascido*" OR "recién nacido*" OR "mortalidade infantil" OR "mortalidad infantil" OR "infant mortality" OR "mortalidade fetal" OR "mortalidad fetal" OR natimort* OR mortinat* OR obstetric* OR miscarriage* OR "aborto espontâneo" OR "aborto espontáneo" OR "spontaneous abortion"). Do not add pulveriz*: it adds agronomy noise.
S2' = (Apodi* OR Jaguaribe* OR Quixer* OR Russas* OR Jaguaruana*) AND (saúde* OR saude* OR health* OR salud* OR agrot* OR pesticid* OR agroneg* OR agribusiness* OR trabalh* OR fruticultura* OR mulheres*)

L1' = L1 OR ((mh:"Pesticides" OR mh:"Agrochemicals" OR mh:"Herbicides" OR mh:"Insecticides" OR mh:"Fungicides, Industrial" OR mh:"Agricultural Workers' Diseases") AND (mh:"Pregnancy Outcome" OR mh:"Infant, Low Birth Weight" OR mh:"Premature Birth" OR mh:"Congenital Abnormalities" OR mh:"Fetal Death" OR mh:"Abortion, Spontaneous" OR mh:"Infant Mortality" OR mh:"Stillbirth" OR mh:"Prenatal Exposure Delayed Effects")).
